_readme: Units allowed to be IDENTICAL to English on a translated page (tools/i18n-check.mjs 0.6).
Entries are keyed by (unit id, English text). Keying on the English text too means a reword
of the English silently REVOKES the allowance and the unit is re-reviewed — which is the
failure mode a whitelist would otherwise have.
pins     — the unit is a proper noun, price, key name or acronym. It SHOULD be identical in
any language, so it is allowed in ALL of them and new languages inherit it free.
cognates — ordinary copy that merely COINCIDES in the named language(s). A new language gets
no free pass: it trips --check once and a human decides. That review is the point.
Derived from evidence, not assumption: every unit was compared across the 18 shipped
languages and bucketed ALWAYS_SAME / ALWAYS_DIFF / MIXED. Re-run it any time with
MIXED is where every leak this wave found was found. Prefer FIXING a leak over declaring it.
